fixture.callback: Contact begin/end counters, without logging in timed steps; record counts after each step.
fixture.ccd: Two static walls, width 0.5 m and height 20 m, centered at x=-10 and x=10 m. Bullet circles alternate direction at 18 m/s from x=+-8 m, y=0.5+(index%20)*0.45 m. Reset at crossing to maintain repeated CCD opportunities.
fixture.diagnostics: After timed stepping, record aggregate absolute linear and angular speed each step. Count full broad-phase candidate pairs using detectIterator(true), and active contact pairs/points, on the first step of each simulated second and the final step. Use -1 for unsampled pair counts; never interpret it as zero.
fixture.dynamic_shape: circle radius 0.25 m, one fixture per body; density 1 kg/m^2, friction 0.5, restitution 0.0
fixture.joint: One dynamic circle and one static 0.25 m square anchor per mechanism at x=3*i m. Disable at-rest detection for the dynamic circles. Mixed rotates the ten types by index. Apply linear impulse (0.5,1.0) kg*m/s and angular impulse 0.01 kg*m^2/s to every dynamic body once per simulated second. Mode parameters are fixed in the harness.
fixture.lifecycle: 10-column pile with the same floor. Every tenth dynamic body has a distance joint to the floor at both centers. Settle has no imposed wake. Wake applies impulse (0.2,0.5) kg*m/s to every tenth body once per simulated second. Replace removes and recreates ceil(1% of bodies) once per simulated second, starting at (17017 + elapsed whole seconds) modulo body count, with the same indexed positions and constant body and joint counts. Removal includes fixture and joint cleanup.
fixture.pile: 10 columns; circle centers at x=(column-4.5)*0.48 m and y=0.3+row*0.48 m; zero initial velocity; floor contact and gravity active.
fixture.separated: Grid pitch 3 m, 32 columns, starting (-48,2) m; zero gravity; all bodies have velocity (0.75,0.0) m/s; wrap by deterministic translation at x=48 m.
fixture.solver: dyn4j 6.0.0 defaults; do not change iteration or sleep settings
fixture.static_shape: rectangles with density 1 kg/m^2, friction 0.5, restitution 0; floor width 200 m and thickness 1 m centered at (0,-0.5) m for pile and lifecycle

measurement_method.confidence: The upper bound of a two-sided 95% block-bootstrap ratio interval must be at or below each relative limit. Evaluate each run and its final minute separately. A crossing interval is inconclusive.
measurement_method.memory: Profile allocation and memory in separate paced processes using the same event schedule as timing. Record construction allocation, post-collection retained heap with the world alive, and RSS from empty harness through construction, warm-up, and measurement. Count managed, native, and Wasm linear storage once. A process RSS delta is a diagnostic until attribution and reserved-memory overhead are validated.
measurement_method.noise: Before candidate runs, obtain three fresh-process pairs of unchanged baseline at each reference environment and workload. Balance pair order. Use one-second paired blocks and 2,000 deterministic bootstrap draws, seed 17017. Retain each pair interval and its raw series.
measurement_method.plateau: After warm-up, run 100 create/use/dispose cycles. Record post-collection live heap, resident process bytes, and collection count. Compare cycles 20-39 with 80-99; drift above 5% or absent reclamation is inconclusive or failing, pending probe attribution.
measurement_method.run_order: Use three fresh matched processes per API. Rotate the order baseline/direct/compatibility, direct/compatibility/baseline, compatibility/baseline/direct so each API occupies every position once. Retain the order and process identity.
measurement_method.sampling: Store every step with mutation time, lateness, allocation, heap, RSS, awake bodies, contact starts and ends, and TOI events. Keep event-only full and final-minute latency distributions. No dropped steps or hidden invalid runs.
measurement_method.tail: Report p99 only with its event count. If an event-only final-minute series has fewer than 100 events, use the full-run distribution for tail context and mark the final-minute tail inconclusive.
measurement_method.timer: Monotonic nanoTime. Measure paired-call positive resolution and median/p99 overhead with 10,000 calls. Keep pauses inside measured step elapsed time. Do not subtract overhead from gate samples.
measurement_method.warmup: Pace at intended cadence for at least 120 wall seconds. Use 30-second windows. The last three window medians must each be within 5% of their median. Reset the fixture after warm-up in the same process. If no convergence by 600 wall seconds, mark inconclusive.
